note: Intensity captions for CS Junkie kill clips (Jord, 26 Oct 2026). Caps hook with player, count and weapon, then a short punchy line. Placeholders: {COUNT} (digits) and {PLAYER} (name as read from the clip), always upper case. Facts with an upper-case key (ADJ, TEAM, COUNTRY, ENEMY_COUNTRY, WEAPON) are filled from tools/clip_lookup/<clip>.json only when high confidence. Lines with a 'needs' list are personalised; generic lines have no 'needs'. Every line keeps the literal 5K-style count token so csj_checker.py step 9 passes. Hashtags are appended by csj_caption_picker.py. Old sentence-case pool: caption_pool_v1_sentence_case.json.
